spans.s: भू-मंडल n. the terrestrial globe.
भू-मत् m. a king, a prince.
भू-मय a. earthen, earthly.
भूमन् (I) m. 1. Abundance, plenty, भूमानमातन्वते M.M.v.; 2. wealth.
भूमन् (II) n. 1. The earth; 2. a piece of ground; 3. a being.(भूम्ना is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘abundantly, for the most part,’ भूम्ना रसानां गहनाः प्रयोगाः M.M.i.)

भूमि f. 1. The earth, भूयः स भूमेर्धुरमाससंज R.ii.74; 2. a territory, a district; 3. land, soil, K.S.i.24; 4. a story, floor; 5. a site, a situation; 6. attitude, posture; 7. a mask, a character (in dramaturgy); 8. subject, object; 9. the tongue; 10. ground, plot of ground, R.i.52, iii.61, vi.31, Rt.i.24; 11. abode, place.
भूमी f. The same as भूमि q.v.
भूमि-अंतर m. a king of an adjacent country.
भूमि-इंद्र, -ईश्वर m. a king, a sovereign.
भूमि-इंद्र, -ईश्वर m. a king, a sovereign.
भूमि-कदंब m. a kind of Kadamba.
भूमि-कंप m. an earthquake.
भूमि-गुहा f. a hole in the ground.
भूमि-गृह n. an underground chamber.
भूमि-चल m. an earthquake.
भूमि-चलन n. an earthquake.
भूमि-ज m. 1. the planet Mars; 2. an epithet of the demon Naraka; 3. a man.
भूमि-जा f. an epithet of Sītā.
भूमि-जीविन् m. a Vaiśya.
भूमि-तल n. the surface of the earth.
भूमि-दान n. a grant of landed property.
भूमि-देव m. a Brāhmaṇa.
भूमि-धर m. 1. a mountain, K.S.vii.54; 2. a king; 3. the number ‘seven.’
भूमि-नाथ, -प, -पति, -पाल, -पुरंदर, -भुज् m. a king, a sovereign, R.i.47.
भूमि-नाथ, -प, -पति, -पाल, -पुरंदर, -भुज् m. a king, a sovereign, R.i.47.
भूमि-नाथ, -प, -पति, -पाल, -पुरंदर, -भुज् m. a king, a sovereign, R.i.47.
भूमी-पति, -भुज् m. a king.
भूमि-नाथ, -प, -पति, -पाल, -पुरंदर, -भुज् m. a king, a sovereign, R.i.47.
भूमि-नाथ, -प, -पति, -पाल, -पुरंदर, -भुज् m. a king, a sovereign, R.i.47.
भूमि-नाथ, -प, -पति, -पाल, -पुरंदर, -भुज् m. a king, a sovereign, R.i.47.
भूमी-पति, -भुज् m. a king.
भूमि-पक्ष m. a swift horse.
भूमि-पिशाच n. the wine-palm.
भूमि-पुत्र m. the planet Mars.
भूमि-भृत् m. 1. a mountain; 2. a king.
भूमि-मंडा f. a kind of jasmine.
भूमि-रक्षक m. a swift horsc.
भूमि-लाभ m. death (in figurative language).
भूमि-लेपन n. cowdung.
भूमि-वर्धन m.n. a dead body, a corpse.
भूमि-शय m. a wild pigeon.
भूमि-शय्या f. sleeping on the ground.
भूमि-शयन n. sleeping on the ground.
भूमि-संभव, -सुत m. 1. the planet Mars; 2. an epithet of the demon Naraka.
भूमि-संभवा, -सुता f. an epithet of Sītā, daughter of Janaka.
भूमि-संभव, -सुत m. 1. the planet Mars; 2. an epithet of the demon Naraka.
भूमि-संभवा, -सुता f. an epithet of Sītā, daughter of Janaka.
भूमि-संनिवेश m. the configuration of a country.
भूमि-स्पृश् m. 1. a man; 2. mankind; 3. a Vaiśya; 4. a thief.

भूमिका f. 1. Earth, soil; 2. a step, a degree, e.g. नैय्यायिकादिभिरात्मा प्रथमभूमिकायामवतारितः; 3. a place, a spot; 4. a story, a floor; 5. a preface, an introduction; 6. decoration of images, temples &c.; 7. board for writing, R.xviii.46; See अक्षरभूमिका; 8. a character in a play, लक्ष्मीभूमिकायां वर्तमानोर्वशो वारुणीभूमिकायां वर्तमानया मेनकया पृष्टा Vikr.iii., या यस्य युज्यते भूमिका तां खलु तथैव भावेन सर्वे वर्ग्याः पाठिताः M.M.i.
भूमी-रुह्, -रुह m. a tree.
भूमी-रुह्, -रुह m. a tree.
